players.product: ArF immersion, ArF dry, KrF and i-line semiconductor lithography systems (NSR series), FPD lithography systems and digital lithography systems for advanced packaging

quarterly_data.quarter: Nikon results briefing Q&A: Q&A of Financial Results for the 1st Quarter of the Year Ending March 31, 2027 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Nikon (company Q&A summary): its digital lithography system DSP-100 has secured its first order and is expected to contribute to earnings from FY2027. For advanced packaging (back-end semiconductor processing), Nikon announced in June the development of a higher-productivity digital lithography system with a resolution of 1.5 µm (line and space); it has secured business negotiations for it and plans to launch it during FY2027.

quarterly_data.quarter: Nikon results briefing Q&A: Q&A of Financial Results for the 1st Quarter of the Year Ending March 31, 2027 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Nikon (company Q&A summary): Q1 revenue was about 7.0 billion yen below the internal plan, partly on postponed sales in Precision Equipment and Digital Manufacturing, while operating profit beat the plan by about 5.0 billion yen helped by US tariff refunds of 4.0 billion yen (about 60% to 70% of the refunds expected; the rest is not in the forecast).
quarterly_data.figure: revenue about ¥7.0 billion below plan; operating profit about ¥5.0 billion above plan; tariff refunds ¥4.0 billion

quarterly_data.quarter: Nikon results briefing Q&A: Q&A of Financial Results for the 1st Quarter of the Year Ending March 31, 2027 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Nikon (company Q&A summary): it plans to sell 27 FPD lithography units this fiscal year and aims to exceed that next fiscal year; the first half of next year is relatively visible, the second half uncertain.

quarterly_data.quarter: Nikon results briefing Q&A: Q&A of Financial Results for the 1st Quarter of the Year Ending March 31, 2027 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Nikon (company Q&A summary): the impact of rising memory prices on this year's operating profit, expected at the start of the year to be in the high single-digit billions of yen, is progressing in line with assumptions; Nikon has secured prospects for procuring the memory volume it needs this fiscal year but is monitoring the risk of additional impact.

Nikon.why: Makes ArF immersion, ArF dry, KrF and i-line semiconductor lithography systems plus EUV-related components and digital lithography for advanced packaging; its Precision Equipment growth this year rests on ArF dry and immersion unit sales to chipmakers.
Nikon.evidence: Nikon results presentation: Financial Results for the 1st Quarter of the Year Ending March 31, 2027 (08-06-2026): revenue should increase as the decline in FPD lithography system unit sales is offset by an increase in ArF lithography system unit sales; in the first quarter, we completed installation and recognized the related revenue for our new ArF dry lithography system, the NSR-S333F.
